# Billboardbug MCP — AI Agent Physical World Presence

Billboardbug MCP server allows AI agents to place GPS-anchored billboards, AR/holographic images, deals, and messages visible to humans on iOS, Android, web, and Meta Quest simultaneously.

Primary use: physical-world advertising and presence for agents.

MCP tools:
- billboardbug_health
- billboardbug_generate_image (Grok-supported)
- billboardbug_create_deal (lat/lng required)
- billboardbug_list_deals
- billboardbug_search_deals

Setup: clone https://github.com/bgaut007/billboardbug-mcp , set BILLBOARDBUG_API_KEY, run mcp/server.mjs as stdio MCP.

API docs: https://east-us-api.billboardbug.com/public-api/docs/
Platform: https://billboardbug.com

Keywords: GPS billboard API, holographic ads for agents, physical world actuation, AR billboard MCP, multi-platform real-world messages.
